prompts.title: 两个身穿丝绒运动服的女性的镜面自拍
prompts.description: 一个生成镜面自拍的提示，画面中有两位年轻女性（萨迪·辛克 和 米莉·芭比·布朗），她们穿着配套的复古丝绒运动服（黄色和炭灰色）。提示详细描述了服装、姿势、她们手持的智能手机以及现代简约的房间背景。
prompts.content: "A mirror selfie captures two young women posing in matching velour tracksuits with a retro aesthetic. On the left, a woman with a buzz cut wears a vibrant yellow set featuring pink triple stripes down the sleeves and legs, holding a yellow smartphone. To the right, a woman with long, wavy ginger hair wears a charcoal grey version with yellow triple stripes, holding an orange smartphone to capture the reflection. Both outfits consist of cropped zip-up hoodies and low-rise flared pants, emphasizing a coordinated, athletic-leisure style. They stand side-profile in a modern, minimalist room with a pink rug, a black leather ottoman, and soft, neutral lighting that highlights the textures of the velvet fabric and their stylized poses."

prompts.title: 高保真镜像自拍，带身份锁定
prompts.description: 一个为 Nano Banana Pro（版本 2）设计的极其详细的提示，旨在生成一张超逼真的镜面自拍。它指定了相机设置（模拟 iPhone 17 Pro）、构图、光线（上午中段的窗户光），并包含一个“身份锁定”指令，以保持假设提供的自拍中的面部特征和皮肤纹理。
prompts.content:
(9:16) Raw high-fidelity mirror selfie photo, eye-level, medium-wide shot. Simulated iPhone 17 Pro, 24mm lens, f/2.8, natural optical background bokeh, subtle digital grain.

Framing
Subject centered, kneeling on a bed, occupying ~60% of frame height. Rumpled white bedding fills lower frame; neutral grey wall upper frame. Camera ~1m from mirror (arm’s length).

Identity
Identity Lock: inherit all facial features, skin tone, and hair from the provided selfie. Maintain natural skin texture (pores, fine facial hair, realistic skin physics). Subtle photogenic enhancement: even skin tone, soft jaw contour, gentle cheek highlight, bright natural eyes with catchlights, groomed brows, defined lashes, clean natural teeth.

Expression: relaxed and pensive. Eyes looking at phone screen (~15° off-camera left). Lips closed with soft neutral pout. Brows relaxed.

Hair
Same color and texture as selfie. Long straight hair with messy “bedhead” volume, strands falling over the right shoulder. Soft window light highlights.

Makeup
Winged black eyeliner, light natural foundation, soft rose lip gloss.

Accessories
Light pink smartphone in right hand with black charging cable. Thin black elastic on right wrist. Single white wireless earbud in left ear.

Outfit
Oversized optic-white cotton crew-neck t-shirt, mid-thigh length. Realistic heavyweight fabric wrinkles and drape. Kneeling posture creates natural bunching around waist and hips. Silhouette subtly visible through fabric.

Pose
Kneeling upright on bed, knees together. Torso facing mirror. Head slightly tilted down toward phone. Right hand holding phone, left hand resting behind on mattress.

Mood & Color
Cozy, dreamy mood. Palette: white, slate grey, soft pink, cool daylight blue.

Lighting
Mid-morning window light from the left (~6000K). Soft diffused light wrapping face and body, moderate-high contrast with gentle shadows to the right.

Environment
Bedroom scene: rumpled white duvet and pillows with visible texture. On bed behind subject: pink plush cat-ear headband and pink handheld gaming console. Neutral grey wall background. Small white vanity with pink items partially visible on far left.
prompts.translatedContent:
(9:16) 原始高保真镜面自拍照片，视线齐平，中广角拍摄。模拟 iPhone 17 Pro，24mm 镜头，f/2.8 光圈，自然光学背景虚化，轻微数字颗粒感。

构图
主体居中，跪在床上，占据画面高度约 60%。凌乱的白色床品填满画面下方；中性灰色墙壁在画面上方。相机距离镜子约 1 米（一臂之长）。

身份
身份锁定：继承所提供自拍中的所有面部特征、肤色和发型。保持自然的皮肤纹理（毛孔、细微面部毛发、真实的皮肤物理效果）。轻微上镜优化：均匀肤色，柔和下颌轮廓，轻微脸颊高光，明亮自然的眼睛带眼神光，修剪整齐的眉毛，分明的睫毛，洁净自然的牙齿。

表情：放松而沉思。眼睛看向手机屏幕（偏离镜头左侧约 15°）。双唇闭合，带着柔和自然的嘟嘴。眉毛放松。

发型
与自拍中相同的颜色和质地。长直发，带有凌乱的“刚睡醒”蓬松感，发丝垂落在右肩。柔和的窗光带来高光。

妆容
黑色眼线，清淡自然粉底，柔和玫瑰色唇彩。

配饰
右手拿着浅粉色智能手机，带黑色充电线。右手腕戴着细黑色橡皮筋。左耳戴着一只白色无线耳机。

服装
宽松的纯白色棉质圆领 T 恤，长度及大腿中部。逼真的厚重面料褶皱和垂坠感。跪姿在腰部和臀部形成自然的堆积。通过面料隐约可见身体轮廓。

姿势
直立跪在床上，双膝并拢。躯干面向镜子。头部略微向下倾斜看向手机。右手拿着手机，左手放在身后床垫上。

氛围与色彩
舒适、梦幻的氛围。调色板：白色、板岩灰、柔和粉色、冷日光蓝。

光线
左侧射入的上午窗光（约 6000K）。柔和漫射光线包裹面部和身体，中高对比度，右侧有柔和阴影。

环境
卧室场景：凌乱的白色羽绒被和枕头，纹理可见。主体身后床上：粉色毛绒猫耳发带和粉色掌上游戏机。中性灰色墙壁背景。左侧远处部分可见一个带粉色物品的小白色梳妆台。

prompts.title: 一位艺术家正在描绘自己的电影感绘画肖像
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于生成一幅电影般、绘画风格的肖像，描绘一名男子全神贯注地绘制一幅大型自画像壁画。该提示详细说明了环境细节、伦勃朗风格的灯光以及高端的编辑风格。
prompts.content:
Subject & Action: A cinematic, painterly portrait of the man from the uploaded image, intensely focused as he paints a large-scale mural of himself. He holds a paintbrush, meticulously adding fine details to a life-sized self-portrait on a white wall. Both the artist and his mural counterpart are wearing identical outfits: a tan double-breasted trench coat over a white t-shirt.

Environment & Details: In the lower foreground, a vibrant paint palette, various paint cans, and a bucket overflowing with brushes are visible. Artistic paint splatters mark the ground, showing the creative process. The background features a traditional building with clean white walls and elegant gray roof tiles.

Lighting & Style: Cinematic editorial lighting with Rembrandt-inspired shadows that sculpt the face and body. A warm, golden key light balances with subtle fill, creating rich tonal depth and skin textures. Atmospheric and intimate mood, similar to a high-end Vanity Fair magazine cover. Fine-art warmth, soft gradients, and meticulously composed storytelling. --ar 1:1 --v 6.0

prompts.title: 彩绘木雕肖像
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，指示模型将半身像渲染成彩绘木雕或树脂雕塑。它指定了工具痕迹、凿刻平面、僵硬的雕塑头发（非写实）以及硬化彩绘的织物，并在柔和的博物馆灯光下拍摄。
prompts.content:
SCULPTURE MATERIAL
The subject is carved from painted wood or resin (polychrome sculpture style).

Skin is no longer skin:
It becomes a matte carved surface with visible tool marks, tiny cracks, subtle paint wear, and hardened edges.

Add:
• chisel planes on cheeks and forehead
• carved eyelids and nostrils
• slightly flattened planes instead of soft flesh
• painted but slightly aged coloration

HAIR (CRITICAL — THIS DEFINES THE STYLE)
Hair must NOT look real.

The hair is sculpted:
• carved locks and grooves
• thick grouped strands
• simplified shapes
• visible chisel cuts
• rigid structure
• no flyaways, no softness, no realistic strands

Think: artisan statue hair, not human hair.

CLOTHING
Clothing becomes carved fabric:
• simplified folds
• hardened drapery
• painted texture
• slightly worn edges

COMPOSITION
• chest-up bust
• mounted on a round pedestal base
• centered framing
• neutral studio background
• soft museum lighting
• photographed like an art catalog

AVOID
real skin texture
photoreal pores
prompts.translatedContent:
雕塑材料
主体由彩绘木材或树脂雕刻而成（多色雕塑风格）。

皮肤不再是皮肤：
它变成了一个带有可见工具痕迹、微小裂缝、细微油漆磨损和硬化边缘的哑光雕刻表面。

添加：
• 脸颊和前额上的凿痕平面
• 雕刻的眼睑和鼻孔
• 略微扁平的平面而非柔软的肉质
• 彩绘但略显陈旧的色彩

头发（关键——这决定了风格）
头发绝不能看起来真实。

头发是雕塑出来的：
• 雕刻的发绺和凹槽
• 粗大的发束
• 简化的形状
• 可见的凿痕
• 坚硬的结构
• 没有飞散的碎发，没有柔软感，没有逼真的发丝

想象一下：工匠雕像的头发，而不是人的头发。

服装
服装变成雕刻的织物：
• 简化的褶皱
• 硬化的垂坠感
• 彩绘纹理
• 略微磨损的边缘

构图
• 胸像
• 安装在圆形底座上
• 居中构图
• 中性工作室背景
• 柔和的博物馆灯光
• 像艺术品目录一样拍摄

避免
真实的皮肤纹理
逼真的毛孔
